made.summary: No page-block spec existed in the repo, project files or hub, so 0.6.0 was frozen as a hardening release (security, short viewports, compatibility, packaging, docs). Page blocks deferred. Documented in docs/releases/0.6.0-scope.md.
Root workspace engines raised to node >=22.13 for dev tooling (ESLint 10, Vitest 5); the published library keeps >=18.18, verified by the Consumer CI matrix.
Package description and README claim WCAG 2.2 AA with AAA contrast (automated checks), not blanket AAA; manual assistive-technology verification is listed as pending.
main is protected on one aggregate check, CI gate; publish.yml verifies every mandatory job itself, so job renames can't silently drop a requirement.
Releases publish the tarball CI built for the exact candidate, after an independent byte-identical rebuild; no rebuild-and-publish.

constraints: Never publish to npm or create release tags without the owner; release approval belongs to Joshua Small.
Every PR targets main; npm scripts must stay cross-platform (Windows).
Do not run npm audit fix --force or disable audit rules or tests.
unresolved: release-provenance is not met for 0.6.0 (no npm attestation, unsigned tag); owner to choose option A, B or C in docs/releases/0.6.0-acceptance.md section E.
Hub registry still records 0.5.0 and releaseStatus not_started; needs an owner-approved registry PR.
Page-block (Phase 5) scope needs an owner-written spec before any work.
Scrollable Popover bodies without focusable content are not keyboard-scrollable in Safari (known limitation, documented).
main has no branch protection or ruleset; agent tools cannot configure it. Owner: ruleset requiring PRs and the CI gate check, no force push or deletion.
npm-publish environment protection and the npm trusted publisher (environment npm-publish) are owner settings; not verified.

Browsers (firefox/webkit) jobs depend on the runner's apt mirror via 'playwright install --with-deps'; one 20-minute timeout on main (run 42140582429 attempt 1). Re-run recovers; a durable fix is open.
